trainer.subject: Wookiee
trainer.desc: Wookiee warrior (Chewbacca's species): very tall, broad hunched shoulders, long layered shaggy fur in several tones: dark grey-brown on the shoulders, arms and legs, lighter caramel and ginger fur around the face and chest, every lock of fur shaded with dark roots and light tips; face fully furred, short dark muzzle with a black nose, small deep-set blue eyes under a heavy furred brow, mouth open showing fangs; bandolier of rectangular silver ammunition boxes on a brown leather strap across the chest; holding a bowcaster (a crossbow-like energy rifle with curved bow arms) in both hands
trainer.pose: standing, facing left, three-quarter view, aiming a crossbow
